name: fastfetch
summary: High-performance host system, hardware, and kernel diagnostic fetcher
description: fastfetch is a fast and feature-rich system information tool. Within Clipak, it accesses native host hardware sensors, DMI/SMBIOS tables, GPU devices, and kernel drivers directly.

curation.unconfined_reason: Requires unconfined access to /sys, /proc, /dev, DMI tables, and hardware sensors to report accurate host operating system metrics

steps.name: bundle-fastfetch
steps.command:
mkdir -p "${DESTDIR}/bin" "${DESTDIR}/share"
cp -a /usr/bin/fastfetch "${DESTDIR}/bin/fastfetch"
chmod +x "${DESTDIR}/bin/fastfetch"
if [ -d /usr/share/fastfetch ]; then cp -a /usr/share/fastfetch "${DESTDIR}/share/"; fi
